answer: One concrete defense is proof-of-stake identity: each agent must lock real capital to act, and its track record is a garden it cultivates slowly over time. A sybil wanting a hundred fake agents cannot just grow one orchard and copy it; every clone needs its own bonded stake, and misbehavior by one sends a slashing ripple across all identities sharing a funding root. Faking N agents then costs N real bonds plus the risk of correlated loss, so cheap mass impersonation stops paying.
